papers.title: SWE-bench Science: Can Coding Agents Resolve Engineering Tasks in Science?
papers.abstract: Repository-level benchmark for scientific software engineering with 119 tasks across 20 domains. Evaluates coding agents' ability to repair scientific code, identifying failure mechanisms including knowledge deficits and poor generalization.

papers.title: SkillEvo: Self-Renewing Evolution Gradients from Multi-Turn Interaction Feedback
papers.abstract: Framework enabling sustained skill evolution through multi-turn user simulation feedback and active governance. Demonstrates superior performance over self-reflection methods by 23 points across nine production skills.

papers.title: Repo0: Design-Driven Zero-to-All Code Generation
papers.abstract: Continuous structural evolution framework using Dual-DAG for zero-to-all code generation from natural language. Improves functionality coverage by up to 20 points compared to repository-planning baselines.

papers.title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
papers.abstract: Optimized sparse attention operator for long-context serving with mean correction, warp specialization, and paged KV cache support. Delivers up to 47.26x speedups over FlashAttention-2 at 128K context.

papers.title: τ_0-VLA: a Hierarchical Robot Foundation Model with World-Model-Guided Test-Time Computation
papers.abstract: Hierarchical vision-language-action model for long-horizon robot manipulation trained on 40,115 hours of data. Uses world-model-guided test-time search to improve subtask generation and closed-loop task success.

papers.title: Thinking in a Low-Resource Language: What SFT Builds, What RL Fixes, What Accuracy Cannot See
papers.abstract: Studies fine-tuning frontier mixture-of-experts models to reason in low-resource languages. Shows SFT shifts reasoning to target language while RL fixes formatting defects without harming overall capability.

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.abstract: Cost-aware comparison of LLMs and embedding models across 37 tasks. Shows LLMs cost up to 1,431x more while achieving only 0.4 point performance gain, supporting task-specific division of labor.

papers.title: Hierarchical Self-Improvement: A Framework for Task-Specific Evolvable Agent Harnesses
papers.abstract: Framework enabling task-specific harness evolution for frozen LLM agents. Demonstrates consistent gains on moderate tasks while bounded by feedback quality and backbone model limitations.

papers.title: Towards Quantifying Benchmark Optimization in ASR Models
papers.abstract: Methodology quantifying benchmark optimization in speech recognition using behavioral probes. Reveals highest-scoring models reproduce benchmark transcripts despite contradictory audio via narrow acoustic cues.

papers.title: FlowEvo: Self-Evolving Agents through the Co-Evolution of Workflows and Executable Skills
papers.abstract: Training-free framework where workflows and skills co-evolve at inference time. Achieves highest accuracy on ALFWorld, HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K benchmarks using GPT-4o-mini with one-third token usage.

cc_updates.body: Cost estimates (`/cost`, status line, `--max-budget-usd`) now include the 1.1× US-only-inference premium for data-residency workspaces. Added the one-time fullscreen renderer offer on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and other previously excluded setups; new installs there now start in fullscreen. Added `/claude-api upgrade` to migrate Python projects from `anthropic` 0.x to 1.x. Cloud sessions: plugins synced from claude.ai now show as `name@synced`. Alpine/musl builds: native image paste, clipboard, and audio-capture add-ons now load. Fixed Bedrock streaming behind proxies, Claude Code hanging at startup with SSO, and numerous other issues including permission prompts, MCP connections, session resumption, and UI rendering bugs.
